title: GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of a differentiable convex function f: ℝᵈ → ℝ. A global minimizer x★ exists with ‖x0−x★‖≤R and f(x0)−f(x★)≤Δ. Strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Each query x returns exactly ∇f(x), for every history and oracle seed. Function values are not supplied. Algorithms may randomize and use arbitrary adaptive query points.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, HasGradientAt condition; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.Query and spec.Reply; LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm, Setup.allowedAlgorithm.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is differentiable everywhere and satisfies ‖D(∇f)(x)‖≤L0+L1‖∇f(x)‖ globally, with L0,L1>0. A globally Lipschitz gradient is not required.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible, Differentiable and fderiv conditions; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean: spec.valid.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Euclidean geometry on ℝᵈ. Writing a=√(L0R²/ε) and b=L1R, the dimension must satisfy d≥⌈2⁴⁶(1+b+a)⁶⌉.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: All parameters d,L0,L1,x0,R,Δ,ε are public; f is accessed through the oracle. Known radius and initial-gap bounds hold for a common minimizer. The parameter regime requires R,ε>0, L0R²≥16ε, b=L1R≥2²⁰, and Δ≥ε max{(2+b)²,√(L0R²/ε)}.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension.lean: Params, spec.Public, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, spec.admissible; LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a point x̂∈ℝᵈ whose objective gap relative to a global minimizer is integrable and satisfies E[f(x̂)−f(x★)]≤ε. No last-iterate or queried-point output restriction is imposed.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: Accuracy is in expectation over the algorithm and oracle seed laws, under a fixed cap on total gradient queries. No almost-sure objective-gap guarantee is required.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex optimization with exact gradients is standard, but this setup combines gradient-dependent curvature, a public initial-gap bound, and explicit parameter-dependent polynomial dimension and accuracy restrictions.

descriptionHtml:
Known-Gap Generalized Smooth Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing a differentiable convex function f:Rd→R, where d is a positive integer. The function f is (L0,L1)-smooth, with L0>0 and L1>0: its differentiable gradient satisfies ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥ everywhere. A given point x0 satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ for a global minimizer x⋆, with R,Δ>0. The oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For ε>0, the goal is an output x¯ with integrable objective gap satisfying EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of the algorithm’s randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Rdf(x). We use the Euclidean norm on Rd and its induced operator norm on linear maps. The algorithm receives d,L0,L1,x0,R,Δ, and ε.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Parameter regime and dimension). The parameters satisfy L0>0,L1>0,R>0,ε>0,16ε≤L0R2,L1R≥220, and Δ≥ε(2+L1R)2,Δ≥εL0R2ε,d≥⌈246(1+L1R+L0R2ε)6⌉.

Assumption 2 (Convexity and generalized smoothness). The function f is differentiable everywhere, and, for every x,y∈Rd and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y). Its gradient is Fréchet differentiable everywhere and satisfies ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥,x∈Rd. Here ∇2f(x) is a linear operator from Rd to Rd.

Assumption 3 (Initial distance and objective gap). There exists a global minimizer x⋆∈Rd such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈Rd,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ.

Queries may be made at any point of Rd. After the allotted gradient calls, the output x¯∈Rd must have an integrable objective gap under P and satisfy EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

comparisonHtml:
Convex f:Rd→R has differentiable gradient satisfying ∥∇2f(x)∥≤L0+L1∥∇f(x)∥, and a minimizer x⋆ with ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and f(x0)−f(x⋆)≤Δ. All parameters are public; access is to exact gradients, with no algorithm restriction. The setup requires L0,L1,R,ε>0, 16ε≤L0R2, L1R≥220, Δ≥εmax{(2+L1R)2,L0R2/ε}, and d≥⌈246(1+L1R+L0R2/ε)6⌉. Target: integrable gap with ∫[f(x^(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε under the execution probability law P. Result (2) constructs a deterministic output. The paired bounds retain a gap: Λ versus Λ2/3 in their gap branches, and logarithms in q.

import LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Bochner.Basic

namespace LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension

open OracleTemplate MeasureTheory

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  L0 : ℝ
  L1 : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ

noncomputable abbrev Params.toGeneralized (p : Params) : GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.Params :=
  { E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d), L0 := p.L0, L1 := p.L1, R := p.R, Δ := p.Δ, x0 := p.x0,
    ε := p.ε }

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d) → ℝ
  Query p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Reply p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  Output p := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p.d)
  publicInput := id
  valid p := 0 < p.L0 ∧ 0 < p.L1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧
    16 * p.ε ≤ p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 ∧ 1048576 ≤ p.L1 * p.R ∧
    p.ε * (2 + p.L1 * p.R) ^ 2 ≤ p.Δ ∧ p.ε * Real.sqrt (p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / p.ε) ≤ p.Δ ∧
    ⌈70368744177664 * (1 + p.L1 * p.R + Real.sqrt (p.L0 * p.R ^ 2 / p.ε)) ^ 6⌉₊ ≤ p.d
  admissible p := GeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.spec.admissible p.toGeneralized
  successful p f output P :=
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.GeneralizedSmoothConvexKnownGapPolynomialDimension
